travelers.name: REI MAKARO
travelers.reason: Astrakov citizen from WARSZAWA, valid Neural ID, just coming home from work. Citizens don't need a manifest (Directive 02). APPROVE.

questions.question_text: What is your address in WARSZAWA-IX-19?
questions.answer_text: Building 442, level 14, unit 7C. Above the old bell tower replica.
Helix Medical Tower. Subcontract through Nightside Labs.

questions.question_text: Have you been outside the wall recently?
questions.answer_text: No. Just the underground to Helix and back.

travelers.name: DAMI VEKSEL
travelers.tell: Her eyes track the scanner. She does not look at you.
travelers.reason: She says her sister works down at the docks. Astrakov is a sealed inland city built on old Wrocław, and there are no docks here, never have been. Her papers check out but her story doesn't. DETAIN.

questions.question_text: How long since you last saw your sister?
questions.answer_text: Almost a year. We talk by relay.

questions.question_text: What does your sister do in Astrakov?
questions.answer_text: She works at the docks. Loading containers near the old Tumski bridge.
questions.contradiction_flag: Astrakov has no docks. The city was built on inland Wrocław. Tumski is a stone bridge over a memorial canal, not a waterfront.

questions.question_text: What is the first thing you will do when you arrive?

travelers.name: OREL THANE
travelers.tell: His hands are shaking. Not from nerves, he's just worn out. He's been waiting in the cold a long time.
travelers.reason: Hawkmoor resident from PRAHA. Directive 03 bans every Hawkmoor traveler, sponsor or no sponsor. By the rules, that's a DENY.

questions.question_text: Why are you trying to enter?
questions.answer_text: Helix has treatment for my daughter Lila. She is seven. Without it she dies in days.
I left her in PRAHA with my sister. There are places where people are not allowed to live, but I will bring her tomorrow if I get in tonight.

questions.question_text: You know Hawkmoor is banned this week?
questions.answer_text: I know. Helix said the sponsorship would override it. They lied to me, didn't they?

travelers.name: JEX HALMOS
travelers.reason: Fourteen years old, and the sponsor field on the manifest just reads UNLISTED (Directive 04). DENY.

questions.answer_text: My mother works late. I take the carriage home alone every day.

questions.question_text: Why is no adult on your manifest?
questions.answer_text: I don't know. They scanned me at the school in WARSZAWA-III. The lady said it was fine.

questions.question_text: Do you have anyone we can call?
questions.answer_text: My mother. Her number is in my Neural ID. Please.

travelers.name: VEN NARITH
travelers.tell: He smiles too quickly when you look up.
travelers.reason: Claims POZNAŃ citizenship and 'work travel,' then says he left the city by the Eastern Strip. Astrakov only has the western corridor toward old Wrocław. The Neural ID is forged. DETAIN.

questions.question_text: What is your address in POZNAŃ-XII-44?
How did you leave the city for this trip?
questions.answer_text: Eastern Strip. Quick flight to Sector C and back.
questions.contradiction_flag: Astrakov has no eastern corridor. Only the western road toward the Wrocław ruins.

questions.answer_text: Listen. Just stamp it. 200 in untraceable scrip. Nobody checks Gate 9 this time of night.
